_note: Hand-written notes for heroes, keyed by unit id: what the DAT cannot say.
Stats are NOT kept here: heroes.hero_catalog reads them from the player's DAT (the 30 hand-typed
stat blocks these replaced all matched the DAT exactly, 2026-10-22).
faction: the side the hero fought for, shown under the name.  category: 'multiplayer' for heroes
a civ trains in ordinary games, else the hero is a campaign/scenario one.
specials: abilities the stats don't show.  Never invent one — only add what is confirmed.

1269 was listed as 'Genghis Khan' until 2026-10-22, but the game names it Girgen Khan (HGKHAN, 170 HP); the real Genghis Khan is 731 (HKHAN).  Its two ability notes (pass-through arrows, +25% flanking) were dropped: neither the user nor the wikis could say which Khan they described.
